sample_data.method: Bundled organizer fixture plus in-browser JSON file upload using the published schema 2.2 shape
sample_data.reset_instructions: Select Reset in the header to restore the bundled 25-case fixture and PUB-01.
sample_data.import_route: Use Load JSON in the shared header on any workspace route. JSON is limited to 5 MiB and validated before replacing current data.

problem_solving_method: A pure TypeScript engine evaluates subject component passes, grade bands, optional bonus, compulsory-fail override, final GPA, and checking flags. The Next.js interface derives the register, per-student audit trace, CSV exports, and three non-exclusive checking queues from the same evaluated result objects. Automated tests cover boundaries, overlap, uploads, exports, judge examples, and all 25 public cases.

R1.evidence: Routes: /dashboard metrics, charts, and four Judge shortcuts; /results full register. Screenshot: docs/screenshots/dashboard-judge-evidence.png. Tests: official fixture compatibility and judge examples in src/domain/engine.test.ts and src/domain/evidence.test.ts. Sources: src/data/P08_school_results_public.json, public/sample-p08-fixture.json, src/data/fixture.ts, src/domain/evidence.ts, components/dashboard-view.tsx.

R2.evidence: Route: /results searchable, class-filtered, sortable, paginated register with Export register CSV and Trace controls. Screenshot: docs/screenshots/results-register-export.png. Tests: grade bands, subject evaluation, GPA evaluation, and CSV export in src/domain/engine.test.ts and src/domain/csv.test.ts. Sources: src/domain/engine.ts, src/domain/csv.ts, components/results-table.tsx.

R3.evidence: Routes: open Trace from a /dashboard Judge shortcut, /results, or /checks. Screenshot: docs/screenshots/student-trace-hard-edge.png shows Imran Sultana with MAT 32/100, uncancelled GPA 4.67, and final 0.00/F. Tests: compulsory override in src/domain/engine.test.ts and published examples in src/domain/evidence.test.ts. Sources: components/student-trace.tsx, src/domain/engine.ts, src/domain/evidence.ts.

Tests: checking-list overlap in src/domain/engine.test.ts and checking-list CSV coverage in src/domain/csv.test.ts. Sources: components/checks-view.tsx, src/domain/engine.ts buildCheckingLists, src/domain/csv.ts.

publication_control.evidence: Case-specific Draft, Checked, Approved, and Published workflow with actionable Open, Verified, Corrected, and Waived review statuses. Checked and Published transitions are blocked while required review items remain open. Tests: src/domain/workflow.test.ts. Sources: src/domain/workflow.ts, components/publication-view.tsx, components/fixture-provider.tsx.

corrections_and_report_cards.evidence: Immutable before/after correction history with reason, time, grade and GPA impact, plus a browser-print report card from the corrected result. Tests: src/domain/corrections.test.ts. Sources: src/domain/corrections.ts, components/corrections-view.tsx.

cohort_anomaly_scanner.evidence: Explainable z-score outliers, class mean gaps, theory/practical percentage gaps, duplicate seven-mark signatures, and repeated total patterns. Each finding states its values and fixed threshold. Tests: src/domain/anomalies.test.ts. Sources: src/domain/anomalies.ts, components/anomalies-view.tsx.

major_design_decisions: Evaluate every rule in a pure domain module independent of React so the official edge cases and CSV output are directly testable.
Check theory and practical component passes before grade-band lookup, preventing a high total from masking a component failure.
Preserve the uncancelled GPA and exact failing-subject decisions when the compulsory-fail override publishes 0.00/F.
Derive all three non-exclusive teacher queues from the same evaluated result model used by the register and trace.
Bundle the organizer fixture and a valid one-case import sample, then validate judge-supplied JSON locally so evaluation requires no secret or external service.
Expose four current-case hard-edge traces on /dashboard so judges can reach the required evidence without searching.
known_limitations: Corrections are stored in an auditable browser-side demo workflow and do not write back to the imported JSON file.
Uploaded fixture, selected case, table filters, corrections and publication state are session-local; Load JSON and Reset clear all office state.
